summary: Iteration 11 - Demand Edit Feature Testing Complete. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend E2E tests passed. Fixed a bug where empty strings in budget fields caused Pydantic validation errors. Key features verified: PUT /api/demands/{id} allows customer to edit title, description, address, budget, deadline, photos. Chat button correctly hidden for customers on open demands. Emergent badge completely removed from index.html. Page title is 'CraftBolt | Platforma pro řemeslníky'.

design_issues.screen: Date picker in edit modal and demand form
issues: Uses browser's default date picker instead of custom shadcn calendar component - minor UX inconsistency (carried over from previous iterations)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test demands created during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demand edit feature fully tested and working. Key behaviors: 1) PUT /api/demands/{id} accepts dict with allowed_fields (title, description, address, latitude, longitude, images, budget_min, budget_max, deadline). 2) Customer can only edit their own demands in 'open' or 'in_progress' status. 3) Admin can edit any demand. 4) Chat button is hidden for customers on 'open' demands (canChat = isCustomer && demand.status !== 'open'). 5) Edit modal has all fields with data-testid attributes. 6) Fixed bug: empty strings in budget fields now converted to null to prevent Pydantic validation errors.

EMPTY_STRING_BUDGET_VALIDATION.description: Fixed Pydantic validation error when budget_min/budget_max were empty strings instead of null
EMPTY_STRING_BUDGET_VALIDATION.root_cause: Frontend was sending empty strings for budget fields, which Pydantic couldn't parse as float
EMPTY_STRING_BUDGET_VALIDATION.fix: Added _fix_demand_data() helper function to convert empty strings to None for numeric fields in all demand endpoints
